desc: Spin Dash (#51) ends into a standstill with the stick let go: from a run, L, the stick let go as the spin starts, and Mario stands once it is over (no run on; a spin where he stands ends standing too: pm64_spin_dash, pm64_spin_clash)
log_must: \[spin\] Mario's spin ends \((its end|a wall)\): \d+ units in \d+ frames, at \([^)]*\), then stands
